data.content_ref: inline:The proposed relation is abstraction, but the content is a structural reformulation of a single verification, not a genuine abstraction. The 'solution class {a : a even, a+2 even, a+4 even, 3a+6=S}' is trivially equivalent to the original instance — the evenness constraints are satisfied by all integers of the same parity and 3a+6=S is a single linear equation yielding a unique solution regardless. Calling this an 'abstraction' inflates a restatement: the artifact has not lifted SRC_005's verification to a class-level principle, it has merely rewritten one concrete check in set notation. The 'REFUTED IF' condition is triggered because parametrizing over S with 3a+6=S produces exactly one candidate for every S (no exhaustion over a class occurs), so no abstraction over the concrete verification has actually occurred.
